# Callouts: Recovery 2.10 - the LaunchPad wired like the cooker: no USB, bench supply on J22

Source: Own photos, raptox's LaunchPad, stitched from photos 04-08 of 2026-11-05 (jumpers as delivered in the photo)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/rec2-10_launchpad-bench-wiring.jpg](../../../images/annotated/rec2-10_launchpad-bench-wiring.jpg)

USB out. 3.3 V from the bench supply on J22 (never 5 V there), the CH340's ground on J22's other GND pin, J9 on, J13 on SOP2 only. The jumper column and the CH340's two signal wires: see the drawing rec2-10_launchpad-jumper-column.
